name: us2-list-projects
description: US2 (FR-004c/FR-005): a connected run with no usable key (the committed config still holds the PROJ placeholder) performs the paginated project/search read sequence and fails closed with exit 4 — the error surface IS the closed question: it lists the accessible projects (key, name, style) and the exact re-run command. stderr, exit, and the call sequence are byte-identical across ports.
